description: The counter styles that number a list: roman, alphabetic, Greek, zero-padded, Armenian, Georgian, Hebrew, the scripts with digits of their own, CJK and the kana, for 1, 4, 12, 25 and 100.

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 340px; height: 1010px; background-color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-content: flex-start; } ol { margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 50px; width: 80px; height: 100px; background-color: #f0f0f0; } .lower-roman { list-style-type: lower-roman; } .upper-roman { list-style-type: upper-roman; } .lower-alpha { list-style-type: lower-alpha; } .upper-alpha { list-style-type: upper-alpha; } .lower-greek { list-style-type: lower-greek; } .decimal-leading-zero { list-style-type: decimal-leading-zero; } .armenian { list-style-type: armenian; } .lower-armenian { list-style-type: lower-armenian; } .georgian { list-style-type: georgian; } .hebrew { list-style-type: hebrew; } .arabic-indic { list-style-type: arabic-indic; } .persian { list-style-type: persian; } .devanagari { list-style-type: devanagari; } .bengali { list-style-type: bengali; } .gujarati { list-style-type: gujarati; } .gurmukhi { list-style-type: gurmukhi; } .kannada { list-style-type: kannada; } .khmer { list-style-type: khmer; } .lao { list-style-type: lao; } .malayalam { list-style-type: malayalam; } .mongolian { list-style-type: mongolian; } .myanmar { list-style-type: myanmar; } .oriya { list-style-type: oriya; } .telugu { list-style-type: telugu; } .thai { list-style-type: thai; } .tibetan { list-style-type: tibetan; } .tamil { list-style-type: tamil; } .cjk-decimal { list-style-type: cjk-decimal; } .cjk-earthly-branch { list-style-type: cjk-earthly-branch; } .cjk-heavenly-stem { list-style-type: cjk-heavenly-stem; } .hiragana { list-style-type: hiragana; } .hiragana-iroha { list-style-type: hiragana-iroha; } .katakana { list-style-type: katakana; } .katakana-iroha { list-style-type: katakana-iroha; }

classification.reason: The numbers are the same fonts through two rasterizers, which differ in anti-aliasing and hinting on every glyph, and the scripts other than Latin and Greek come from whatever fonts the system has for them.
